title: Spike: evaluate sqlx compile-time query checking for this schema
description:
Evaluate whether sqlx compile-time query checking (SQLX_OFFLINE=true, sqlx prepare) is feasible for the log storage schema. Document: setup steps, CI integration, maintenance burden when schema changes, comparison to runtime-only checking. Artifact: docs/sqlx_offline.md. No production code changes.

Acceptance: document covers setup, CI integration, trade-offs; concludes with a recommendation (adopt or defer); no code changes required by this issue
notes:
Research findings (2026-04-19):

Current state: All three crates (core, reader, transit) use runtime sqlx::query(), sqlx::query_scalar(), and sqlx::query_as() exclusively. No compile-time query! macros are used anywhere. No .sqlx/ offline cache directory exists. No .env or DATABASE_URL configuration is present in the workspace.

Sqlx usage breakdown:
- crates/core: msgid_map.rs (4 query sites), group_log/sqlite_storage.rs (9 query sites) -- separate SQLite schema for group log and message-ID mapping
- crates/reader: store/overview.rs (2 query sites), store/article_numbers.rs (5 query sites) -- separate SQLite schema for article numbers and overview index
- crates/transit: not yet implemented (src directory exists but no sqlx usage found)

Compile-time query! requirements: DATABASE_URL env var must point to a live SQLite database with all migrations applied at build time. With three crates having separate schemas, this means three separate databases, three separate DATABASE_URL configs, or a combined schema database -- none of which is straightforward. The sqlx offline cache (.sqlx/) approach would require running sqlx prepare per crate after every schema migration, and checking in the generated metadata. CI would need to set up databases before cargo build runs.

Tradeoffs:
- Benefits of query!: column type errors caught at compile time; IDE autocomplete; .get(0) mismatches caught before runtime
- Costs: DATABASE_URL complexity per crate; sqlx prepare step in dev workflow; migration discipline required before adding any query; early-stage schemas change frequently
- Current runtime approach: working, all tests pass, explicit column indices/types are readable

Recommendation: Keep runtime sqlx::query() for now. Revisit when schema is stable (post-v1 milestone) and CI infrastructure is mature enough to maintain per-crate databases.
